scope: Independent read-only static review of dedicated Thai touch-phone browser cases and actual control/presentation/DOM helpers. No tests executed and no compiled-bundle result claimed.

findings.reason: nav.5 exists only in sidebar navigation. At 390 CSS px phone Settings publishes nav.current choice, so tapControl(nav.5) waits for an absent key then times out. Touch categories omit Controls; Player is popup index 4.

Snapshot width/height report drawing buffer or canvas backing dimensions, not CSS viewport. A real 2x backing surface is 780x1688 for this viewport; waiting for 390x844 can time out when requested density works. Existing high-density viewport test explicitly expects doubled backing size.
findings.minimal_fix: Assert Module.presentationMetrics.width,height for CSS viewport; assert actual devicePixelRatio===2 and independently assert backing snapshot dimensions [780,1688].

findings.reason: Configured deviceScaleFactor=2 does not establish actual density after navigation. Existing viewport test documents Firefox COOP process navigation resetting emulated density. Current test can silently run at 1x and pass the incorrect CSS-size backing assertion.
findings.minimal_fix: After page.goto, reapply page.setViewportSize(page.viewportSize()) and assert devicePixelRatio===2, as the existing high-density fixture does. Reassert after reload if density then is part of the claim.

findings.reason: The old portrait field bounds may already fit the landscape rectangle before a game frame processes resize; bounding-box check alone does not prove rotation completed.
findings.minimal_fix: After resize, await Module.presentationMetrics.width,height == [844,390] and backing dimensions [1688,780] before input/bounds/screenshot assertions; optionally assert input remains focused.

checked_without_new_findings: hasTouch:true/deviceScaleFactor:2 nested test.use applies to serial/threaded cases in all chromium/firefox/webkit projects
Audio and hand first-run footer control keys exist and persist their explicit choices
Introduction intro/menu key exists; storage-failure continuation is outside expected successful persistence path
Main-menu settings helper detects phone menu/settings and uses bounds conversion
Native text bridge publishes requested data-i18n-aria and translated aria-label; fill raises input and preferences poll waits for native save
Module.storage.flush promise awaited before reload; cookies/context retained across reload; context isolation supplies fresh cases
